about.title: About ClickForNothing — Discover the Useless Internet
about.description: Learn what ClickForNothing is, why it exists, and how it helps you discover funny, weird, random and completely unnecessary websites across the internet.
about.heading: About ClickForNothing
about.intro: ClickForNothing is an entertainment website that helps people discover funny, weird, random and completely unnecessary websites from around the internet. Its core experience is simple: click a button, get sent somewhere unexpected, and waste a little time on something you absolutely did not need.
about.what_is_body: ClickForNothing is a curated discovery platform for useless websites—the wonderfully weird, pointless, and completely unnecessary corners of the internet that serve no practical purpose but somehow entertain, surprise, or confuse you in the best way possible.
about.why_exist_body: We believe the best parts of the internet are the weird, pointless, and unnecessary ones. They represent creativity, humor, and the pure joy of making something just because you can.
